relationships.subject: CGRP monoclonal antibodies
relationships.evidence_quote: Following 12 months of CGRP (pathway) mAb treatment, there was a significant decrease in MMD among episodic (9.38 vs. 3.84 MMD, p = .001) and chronic migraine patients (14.50 vs. 7.03 MMD, p < .001).

key_findings: Mandatory treatment break after 12 months of CGRP mAbs increased monthly migraine days by about 5 days in EM and CM
83% of patients were dissatisfied with the treatment break; no clear disease modification
